component.name: Aura
component.summary: Mac-inspired modern software hub and package explorer for Arch Linux

description.p: Aura is an ultra-fast, modern GTK4/libadwaita software center designed for Arch Linux, CachyOS, and AUR users with an authentic macOS App Store aesthetic.

ul.li: Instant fuzzy search across official Pacman repositories and AUR via Paru
Isolated OCI container sandbox using native Docker for desktop applications
Lifetime passwordless mode with encrypted local credentials vault
System updates manager with one-click batch upgrades
Native Wayland and Hyprland tiling window manager support
Liquid 60FPS fluid spring animations and macOS micro-interactions
